title: Who Regulates Whom
hook: The airlines’ club is chaired by an airline.
stamp: A club isn’t a regulator. A regulator should still answer its mail.

scenes.text: ICAO: a UN body of states that sets global standards. Our agency: the national regulator. IATA: the airlines’ trade association.
This year the IATA board chair is the CEO of the very airline in the file. The role rotates among airline CEOs. That’s what a club is, not a conspiracy.
panel: agm held in rio de janeiro

scenes.text: Nothing in these documents shows anyone coordinating. The remedy is boring: a named decision-maker, the decision text, the date. Ask for those. In writing.
